title: Her Handwriting
text: "Send me the picture, Femi." A long pause on the channel. The wind fills it.

lines.text: "It's my handwriting. The loop on the M. I've done that since school. I did it on every form before we launched."
"Somebody with my name and my hand flew a ship here and died in the sand before I was born. Before I was anything."
"Tell me you didn't know. Machine. Tell me that, at least."

choices.label: "I didn't know."
choices.reply: "No. No, I don't suppose you did. I don't suppose anyone tells you anything either."

choices.label: "I think it has happened to us too."
choices.reply: A long breath. "Then it isn't a ghost story. It's a pattern. Get my people home."

notes: The turn of the Kindred arc: "It's my handwriting."
